retrievalProfile.description: A structured 1960s-style layout featuring a horizontal header band, large stacked serif titles, and a central geometric stained-glass window illustration.

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-tier vertical composition starting with a mustard-yellow 'Stereo' banner, followed by high-contrast stacked serif typography in magenta and cyan, and anchored by a central arched stained-glass window with abstract geometric panes.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal yellow banner contrasts with white background
Stacked magenta and cyan titles create primary focal point
Arched window provides a heavy geometric anchor at the bottom
Small orange secondary text acts as a bridge between title and image
coreInvariants: Arched stained glass window with black lead lines
White negative space surrounding the central illustration

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The title text occupies the upper-middle third; the stained glass window is centered in the bottom half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The arched stained glass window at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: Yellow banner to bold titles, through the list of tracks, ending on the colorful window graphic.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space on the left and right of the central window and between text blocks.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primary and secondary colors against a clean white field.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast in main titles
Wide, expanded proportions for header text
Uniform stroke weight for secondary track lists
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely wide 'S' and 'E' in the yellow banner
Sharp, pointed serifs on the magenta and cyan titles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-wide slab serifs and high-contrast modern serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif style of the main titles
Matches the wide, blocky feel of the top banner text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a white canvas with a mustard yellow horizontal bar at the top. In the bottom center, place an arched stained-glass window illustration with thick black lead lines and geometric panes in green, yellow, blue, and red.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase serif text. The top banner text should be ultra-wide and gold-brown. Below the banner, stack two lines of large serif text in magenta and cyan. Beneath that, add three lines of smaller orange serif text separated by small squares.

verificationChecks: Is the yellow banner at the very top?
Are the main titles stacked and color-coded?
Is the stained glass window centered and arched?
Is the overall aesthetic 1960s graphic design?

adjustableVariables: Color of the stained glass panes
Width of the top yellow banner
Alignment of the track list text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or record label logos
The exact arrangement of the stained glass panes

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on all graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Text is perfectly horizontal and aligned
Stained glass window is symmetrical in its outer arch
White space feels intentional and clean
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow banner + Stacked Serif Titles + Geometric Arched Illustration = 1960s Mid-Century Layout
